scope: Additive primary-source Archer Puppet L1-18 Queen DPS/recovery, summoned Archer invisibility and historical spawn-rate table; combat and child lifecycle remain partial.
game_version: Supercell September 2024 and February 2025 balance announcements; current September 2026 executable, later unlisted changes and child implementation details are unverified.

sources.title: 關於9月平衡性調整即將上線的公告！ (Announcement of Upcoming September Balance Changes!)
facts: The September 2024 note introduces five summoned Archers every one second at all Equipment levels and prints post-change invisibility duration for L1-18.
sources.limitations: It does not give the first spawn phase, current total count, child level, formation, collision, invisibility start/end tick or target-loss semantics.

sources.title: 英雄裝備平衡性調整！ (Hero Equipment Balance Changes!)
facts: The post-buff table prints Queen DPS increase and HP recovery for each L1-18 Equipment level; every pair matches the retained normalized records.
sources.limitations: The table does not define DPS-to-hit arithmetic, deployment/activation phase, recovery cap or same-tick damage/death order.

derivations.result: All 18 retained invisibility durations and Queen DPS/recovery pairs have direct primary numeric corroboration; the historical spawn-rate announcement is five units every 1000 ms.
derivations.method: Compare the official 2024 duration table and 2025 post-buff columns level by level to immutable normalized source_fields; retain batch-rate evidence separately from the unsourced total-count lifecycle.

rejected_inferences.rule: Spawn every retained Archer at the activation tick
rejected_inferences.reason: The 2024 note states five per second, but initial phase and current total-count continuity are not specified.

rejected_inferences.rule: Assume the frozen summonedArcher counts define the final partial batch
rejected_inferences.reason: The official rate table gives no total count or rule for ending the summon.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use the current ordinary Archer troop level for spawned Archers
rejected_inferences.reason: Neither official table defines the Equipment child level or stat mapping.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply invisibility to the Queen or make children immune to splash and traps
rejected_inferences.reason: Only spawned Archer invisibility is specified, with no target-loss or splash/trap contract.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply Queen recovery before lethal damage or add DPS to each hit
rejected_inferences.reason: The tables provide amounts, not battle phase, damage conversion, healing cap or order.

items: current total summon count and invisibility continuity
first and later spawn-group ticks and final batch
child Archer level, formation, collision and deterministic entity-ID allocation
invisibility start/end tick, target loss, splash and trap handling
Queen DPS bonus conversion, recovery cap and activation/death order
Magic Mirror, Invisibility Vial, Pet and second Equipment interactions
Viewer summon art and overlay, snapshot, replay and RL activation state

conclusion: Official tables confirm Archer Puppet L1-18 Queen DPS/recovery and spawned Archer invisibility values, plus a historical five-unit-per-second rate. Child lifecycle and effect ordering remain partial, so no combat actor is enabled.
